purpose: Attach both Hero awakening stages from the pinned UnityDataTool parsed ConfigData snapshot: stage I materials for the skill COST limit unlock and stage II materials for the explicit Level2 awakening skill, without inferred identity or relation edges.

relationContract.heroAwaken: hero-basic-combat.records[].heroId -> ConfigDataAwakenInfo.ID by explicit numeric equality
relationContract.stage1: The same ConfigDataAwakenInfo row's Awaken1LevelID and Awaken1Material[] preserved in source order
relationContract.awakeningSkill: ConfigDataAwakenInfo.Level2SkillID when it is a positive integer
relationContract.stage2: The same ConfigDataAwakenInfo row's Awaken2LevelID, Awaken2Unlock and Awaken2Material[] preserved in source order

normalizationRules: Consume only hero-basic-combat status PASS with the current canonical hero population.
Resolve ConfigDataAwakenInfo only by explicit hero ID equality.
Every canonical Hero must have a source AwakenInfo row with a positive Awaken1LevelID and non-empty Awaken1Material list; otherwise fail closed.
Preserve Awaken1Material source order exactly and resolve each item only by GoodsType 6 plus explicit numeric Item ID equality.
A Hero has a displayable awakening skill only when Level2SkillID is a positive integer.
Do not use Awaken2Unlock as the awakening-skill admission gate; it is preserved only as source evidence when present.
For a defined Level2SkillID, preserve Awaken2Material source order and require a non-empty material list.
Do not join by names, numeric ranges, ID arithmetic, filename similarity, UI order, or historical output.
Do not synthesize Level2SkillID or either stage's materials when the source does not define them.
Fail closed on duplicate source IDs, malformed goods, missing AwakenInfo, unresolved Item IDs, unsupported GoodsType, or generated/source mismatch.

PASS: The generated Hero population exactly matches hero-basic-combat.
Each canonical Hero resolves only by heroId -> ConfigDataAwakenInfo.ID.
Each Hero preserves same-row Awaken1LevelID and Awaken1Material in source order.
Each positive Level2SkillID preserves same-row Awaken2Material in source order.
Every material has GoodsType 6, positive integer Id and Count, and resolves exactly once to ConfigDataItemInfo.ID.
Heroes without a positive Level2SkillID remain explicit stage-II non-display records while retaining their verified stage-I payload.
FAIL: Any upstream, identity, cardinality, ordering, GoodsType, material count, Item snapshot, or source parity mismatch occurs.

completionRule: Run the producer against the current pinned ConfigData source-pack, then run the independent validator. Completion requires generated status PASS, summary status PASS, validator PASS, frontend build PASS, no hard errors, and no unexpected repository mutation.
